newsitem.title: FRANCE: Remy to benefit partly from dollar rise.
newsitem.headline: Remy to benefit partly from dollar rise.

text.p: French drinks group Remy-Cointreau said on Wednesday that it expected to benefit only partly from the dollar's rise due to the currency positions taken by the group.

"In 1996/97, Remy-Cointreau made big efforts in creativity, innovation and support for its brands to build a foundation for solid and durable growth. Nonetheless, given the currency positions taken by the group, Remy-Cointreau will benefit only partly from the dollar's recent recovery. The group plans to pursue all actions to preserve its profitability and improve its financial equilibria," Remy said in its 1996/97 earnings statement.
It said that, "confident in the important sales recovery efforts made this year and the positive effects expected," it would propose an unchanged dividend at the annual general meeting on August 26.
